intro: Grenada is the 'Spice Isle', a small Caribbean nation famous for nutmeg.

chapters.title: Kalinago resistance
text: The Kalinago resisted French settlers in the 1650s; at Sauteurs, the last Kalinago are said to have leapt from a cliff rather than surrender.

chapters.title: French and British rule
text: France ruled Grenada until Britain took it in 1763. Julien Fédon led a rebellion in 1795. Slavery ended in the 1830s.

chapters.title: Independence and revolution
text: Grenada became independent in 1974. In 1979 Maurice Bishop led a revolution; in 1983 he was killed in a power struggle, and the US invaded days later. Democracy was restored. Hurricane Ivan in 2004 and Hurricane Beryl in 2024 caused great damage.

highlight.text: The US-led invasion followed Bishop's killing.

keyTerms.meaning: A spice from a tree seed.
